attribution: KIP126 contributors. The pinned source repository LICENSE is MIT and is preserved verbatim in the source archive. Original per-file copyright or license notices are retained as written and are not reclassified. The AimPaper article is attributed separately to its authors/arXiv in aim-paper-sources.json; no repository license is asserted for the article.
source_policy: This is a partial proof port to fixed callable upstream APIs, not a claim that every original proof has been ported. Existing proof text is archived for review. Archived concrete implementations and raw-program interpretation code are never imported by current mathematical modules.

status_definitions.original-paper-target-without-proof: The pinned source recorded an actual-model target as a proposition definition without a proof. Turning it into a callable pending theorem does not mean its proof existed previously.
status_definitions.existing-proof-archived-port-pending: The referenced old declaration/argument has a proof body without a direct sorry; current type-compatible adaptation remains pending. This does not certify the old proof transitive dependencies.
status_definitions.original-paper-proof-gaps-retained: A direct proof gap already occurred in the pinned article implementation. It remains a paper-local obligation, not an accepted outside fact.
status_definitions.original-paper-proof-gaps-and-proof-port: Both original proof gaps and adaptation of already written proof text remain.
status_definitions.external-upstream-duty: Construction, compatibility, cited external theorem or computation correctness belongs to its upstream module, even if legacy source lived under Main. It is not repeated as a Main obligation.
status_definitions.adapted-proof-body-present: Current proof body has no direct sorry. Its transitive dependencies may still contain pending upstream or local paper proofs.
